def compute_cost(number, max_len, p={1: 11}):
    if len(p) == 1:
        for i in range(2, 17):
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1
    if max_len == 0:
        return 0
    base = p[max_len]
    quotient = number // base
    remainder = number % base
    cost = quotient * max_len
    if remainder != 0:
        optionA = compute_cost(remainder, max_len - 1, p)
        optionB = max_len + compute_cost(base - remainder, max_len - 1, p)
        cost += min(optionA, optionB)
    return cost

n = int(input())
print(compute_cost(n, 16))
